column1: 30051§consonant§ˈkɒnsənənt§n. 辅音 adj. 一致的；符合的§The Arapaho language of the Plains region in the United States has 16 vowel and consonant sounds.§美国大平原地区的阿拉帕霍语有 16 个元音与**辅音**音位。§English dialects of the Upland South, a region stretching from Oklahoma to western Virginia, place similar emphasis on “r” at the ends of syllables and before other consonant sounds.§上南方（从俄克拉何马绵延至弗吉尼亚西部的地区）的英语方言，同样着重音节末尾及其他**辅音**之前的 r 音。§§consonant with 与…一致的（正式书面用法）；vowel n. 元音（真题对举：16 vowel and consonant sounds）；consonance n. 一致，和谐；dissonance n. 不和谐（音乐术语亦用）§§改译文2：similar 指与前文所说的方言相似，原译成「彼此相近」

30052§curate§kjʊˈreɪt§v. 策划（展览）；为展览挑选编排作品；精心挑选并编排（歌单、内容）§Such stylistic diversity is encouraged in part by the music-streaming app Spotify, whose curated playlist of hyperpop songs balances cohesion with variety.§这种风格上的多样性在一定程度上得益于音乐流媒体应用 Spotify——它经过**精心编排**的 hyperpop 歌单在连贯性与多样性之间取得了平衡。§These experts advocate that instead of attempting to manipulate emotional responses with scents, museums should curate exhibits that enable meaningful connections with historical objects.§这些专家主张：与其试图用气味操纵情绪反应，博物馆不如**策展**能让观众与历史物件建立有意义联结的展览。§§curated playlist 精心编排的歌单；curator n. 策展人；馆藏负责人；curatorial adj. 策展的§数字语境引申为精心挑选并编排歌单、藏品、内容§

30053§diffuse§dɪˈfjuːs§v. 扩散；散布；传播（光、热、气味、思想） adj. 弥漫的；分散的；（文章）冗长散漫的§The shift from a top-down model of authorship to a more diffuse, interactive one explicitly positioned readers as creators of meaning and implicitly acknowledged the broader social contexts around literary production.§作者身份从自上而下的模式转向一种更为**分散**、更具互动性的模式，这一转变明确把读者定位为意义的创造者，也含蓄地承认了文学生产所处的更广阔的社会语境。§§§§diffusion n. 扩散；传播（真题另现 6 次：cultural diffusion）§作形容词读 dɪˈfjuːs，作动词读 dɪˈfjuːz；与 confuse 形近异义：confuse 是「使困惑；混淆」§

30054§diversification§daɪˌvɜːsɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§n. 多样化；（物种、语言、经济、投资的）分化，多元化§Thus, the geographical circumstances that favor the development of isolates may also drive diversification within language families.§因此，有利于孤立语发展的地理条件，也可能推动语系内部的**分化**。§To study the joint environmental and economic effects of diversification practices (which can encompass improved soil and water management as well as increased variety in crops and livestock), Laura Vang Rasmussen and team analyzed data from 2,655 farms in eleven countries.§为研究**多样化**实践（可包括更好的土壤与水管理，以及作物和牲畜种类的增加）对环境与经济的共同影响，Laura Vang Rasmussen 团队分析了来自 11 个国家 2,655 个农场的数据。§[构词] diverse（多样的）→ diversify（v.）→ diversification（n.）§drive diversification 推动分化（真题搭配）；diversify v. 使多样化；diversity n. 多样性§§

30055§elicit§iˈlɪsɪt§v. 引出；诱出；激起（反应、回答、兴趣、情感）§In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M. C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information.§在关于 advergames（为推广产品或服务而开发的电子游戏）研究的元分析中，Zeph M.C. van Berlo 等人确认：这类游戏虽然能够**激发**玩家兴趣，却未必有助于玩家日后回忆产品与品牌信息。§Subsequent to simulating an attack to elicit defense responses in three caterpillar species, ecologists placed a treatment group of those individuals in an enclosure where they were exposed to slight, harmless ambient electric field shifts like those created by common predatory wasps in flight.§为**诱发**三种毛虫的防御反应，生态学家先模拟了一次攻击；随后把这些毛虫的处理组放入围栏，让它们暴露于轻微无害的环境电场变化中——类似常见捕食性胡蜂飞行时产生的电场扰动。§§elicit a response 引发反应；elicit interest 激起兴趣§与 illicit（非法的）形近异义，是经典陷阱；elicit 强调「把反应引出来」，evoke 强调「唤起记忆、情感」§

30056§fossilize§ˈfɒsəlaɪz§v. （使）成化石；（使）僵化，使陈旧§Scientists looking for signs of ancient life in Asia have found many examples of fossilized hominins, including in a geological formation at the Minatogawa Limestone Quarry.§在亚洲寻找远古生命迹象的科学家已发现许多古人类**化石**，其中包括港川石灰岩采石场某处地质构造中的化石。§In 1990, archaeologists in Lesotho, in southern Africa, discovered a fossilized phalanx of a Massospondylus carinatus dinosaur in a cave once inhabited by humans.§1990 年，考古学家在南部非洲的莱索托一处曾有人类居住的洞穴中，发现了一块恐龙（Massospondylus carinatus）的指骨**化石**。§§fossilized remains 化石遗骸（真题搭配）；fossilized ideas 僵化的观念；fossil n. 化石；fossilization n. 石化（作用）§§改译文：原译文是另一句（1895 年发现的化石遗骸）；改例句2：句末「..」多了一个句点

30057§glean§ɡliːn§v. （一点一滴地）搜集（信息、线索）；拾（穗）；（鸟类）拾食，啄食§The Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging (CLSA-ÉLCV) is a longitudinal study surveying approximately 1,000 individuals in Canada to glean extended trends in aging.§加拿大老龄化纵向研究（CLSA-ÉLCV）是一项纵向研究，对加拿大约 1,000 名个体进行调查，以**逐步摸清**老龄化方面的长期趋势。§Glyphorynchus spirurus (the wedge-billed woodcreeper), on the other hand, practices bark gleaning (picking insects off the bark of trees), substantially limiting the bird's field of vision while foraging.§而楔嘴䴕雀则采取树皮**拾取**式觅食（从树皮上啄取昆虫），觅食时视野受到极大限制。§§glean insights / trends 获取认识 / 摸清趋势；bark gleaning 树皮拾食；foliage gleaning 叶面拾食；gleaner n. 拾穗者；搜集者§本义是收割后拾散落的谷穗，引申为一点一滴地搜集；与 clean 形近，勿看走眼§改例句2：insects of the bark 的 of 应为 off

30058§heterogeneous§ˌhetərəˈdʒiːniəs§adj. 由不同成分组成的；异质的；混杂的§Richard Hosier and Jeffrey Dowd's study of fuel use in Zimbabwe shows how reductive this model is, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the local prices of different fuel sources.§然而，Richard Hosier 与 Jeffrey Dowd 对津巴布韦燃料使用情况的研究表明，这一模型是何等简化：家庭燃料使用是**混杂**而灵活的，并受到包括不同燃料当地价格在内的多种因素影响。§§§[构词] hetero-（异）+ gen（种类）+ -ous§homogeneous adj. 同质的；均匀的（反义词，常成对出现）；heterogeneity n. 异质性§§

30059§juvenilia§ˌdʒuːvəˈnɪliə§n. （作家的）少年习作，青少年时期作品；（贬）不成熟的作品§Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia—writings by children and teenagers—tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as Charles Dickens’s poem “The Bill of Fare,” which he wrote around the ages of 18-20, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development.§学界对文学**少年习作**——儿童与青少年所写的作品——的兴趣，往往集中于那些后来成名的作家未发表的作品，例如查尔斯·狄更斯 18 至 20 岁左右所写的诗《菜单》，因为这些作品为了解作者的艺术成长提供了线索。§But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford's novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.§但也有学者主张，挖掘知名度较低作家的**少年习作**对理解文学史必不可少：Daisy Ashford 童年发表的小说曾广为同时代读者阅读，因此值得更密切的关注。§§§常指作家成名前的青少年作品，是研究其艺术成长的素材§改例句：「18- 20」删去多余空格

30060§propagate§ˈprɒpəɡeɪt§v. 传播；扩散（波、声、光、思想）；繁殖，增殖§Studies of ocean wave breaking have predominantly focused on traveling waves (those propagating along the horizontal plane), so Mark McAllister et al. utilized a circular wave tank to produce and study spike waves, axisymmetric standing waves that can erupt vertically when traveling waves propagating in opposing directions intersect.§对海浪破碎的研究主要关注的是行波（即沿水平面**传播**的波），因此 Mark McAllister 等人使用了圆形波槽来生成并研究尖峰波：这是一种轴对称驻波，当沿相反方向传播的行波相交时，会垂直喷涌而起。§High-entropy alloys (HEAs) have been observed to have greater fracture toughness—greater resistance to crack propagation—than conventional alloys.§人们观察到，高熵合金（HEA）的断裂韧性——即抵抗裂纹**扩展**的能力——高于传统合金。§§propagate plants by cuttings 用插条繁殖植物；propagation n. 传播；繁殖；crack propagation 裂纹扩展；disseminate v. 散布（信息）（近义）§真题取「（波）传播」义，不是「宣传」§改译文：漏译后半句（尖峰波的定义）；补译文2

30061§satirical§səˈtɪrɪkl§adj. 讽刺的；含讽刺意味的§The Vortex is a 1924 satirical play by Noel Coward.§《漩涡》（The Vortex）是诺埃尔·科沃德 1924 年的一部**讽刺**剧。§§§§satirical portrayal / novel 讽刺性描绘 / 讽刺小说；satire n. 讽刺（作品）；satirize v. 讽刺§satirical 是形容词，satire 是名词，satirize 是动词；与 saturnine（阴沉的、忧郁的）形近易混§

30062§ubiquitous§juːˈbɪkwɪtəs§adj. 无处不在的；随处可见的；普遍存在的§Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.§Ostrander 等人认为这一解释站不住脚：他们发现，一个导致 IGF1（一种存在于许多哺乳动物体内、调控胰岛素样生长因子 1 生成的基因）变异的突变，在家犬各品种中**普遍存在**。§However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.§然而 Nunez 及同事声称，这一倾向实际上并非**无处不在**。§§§语气强于 common：真题 is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds 强调「几乎所有犬种都有」§

30063§underlie§ˌʌndəˈlaɪ§v. 位于…之下；构成…的基础；是…的根本原因§This hypothesis was based on findings about a specific form of rhythmic complexity known as syncopation (when beats played in the rhythm deviate from the steady, underlying pulse of a song), which suggested that moderate syncopation was associated with the highest groove ratings.§这一假说基于对一种特定节奏复杂形式——切分（即所奏节拍偏离歌曲稳定而**潜在**的基本律动）——的研究发现，该发现表明中等程度的切分与最高的律动感评分相关。§The CNN model's output aligned with results of prior studies by other researchers measuring muscle activity patterns directly—one of several indications, said Melis et al., that the model accurately represents important biomechanical processes underlying wing motion.§CNN 模型的输出与其他研究者直接测量肌肉活动模式的既有研究相符——Melis 等人称，这是该模型准确表征翅膀运动**背后**重要生物力学过程的诸多迹象之一。§§underlying adj. 潜在的；根本的（真题 10 次，几乎只用此形；the underlying pulse 潜在的基本律动）§与 underline（在…下划线；强调）形近异义§改译文：末尾漏译 the highest groove ratings

30064§wobble§ˈwɒbl§v. 晃动；摆动；摇摆 n. 晃动；摆动§The radial velocity method detects tiny wobbles in stars caused by orbiting planets pulling on them.§径向速度法通过探测恒星因绕行行星引力牵引而产生的微小**摆动**来发现行星。§As the exoplanet 17 Scorpii b orbits a star 408 light-years from Earth, the gas giant’s gravity causes the star to wobble.§当系外行星 17 Scorpii b 环绕一颗距地球 408 光年的恒星运行时，这颗气态巨行星的引力使恒星发生**摆动**。§§tiny wobbles in stars 恒星的微小摆动§天文学径向速度法（radial velocity method）通过恒星的微小摆动推断绕行行星的引力牵引§

30065§acquisition§ˌækwɪˈzɪʃn§n. （知识、技能、语言的）获得，习得；（企业）收购；（博物馆、图书馆）新入藏品§A soil’s microbial community (the microbial taxa present in their relative abundances) is known to affect plants’ nutrient acquisition.§众所周知，土壤的微生物群落（即其中存在的各微生物类群及其相对丰度）会影响植物对养分的**获取**。§Cognitive scientists have noted, however, that existing domain knowledge facilitates the acquisition of new information in that domain.§然而认知科学家指出，已有的领域知识会促进该领域新信息的**获取**。§§language acquisition 语言习得；the acquisition of new memories 新记忆的习得；nutrient acquisition 养分获取；mergers and acquisitions 并购§§改译文：原译文是另一句（扇形细胞与记忆）

30066§attributable§əˈtrɪbjətəbl§adj. 可归因于…的；由…引起的§Finding that knockout mice with the gene Aasdh deactivated tended to develop cataracts more frequently than did wild-type mice, the students concluded that differences in cataract frequency among house mice in nature are solely attributable to variations in the level of expression of Aasdh.§学生们发现，Aasdh 基因被敲除的小鼠比野生型小鼠更容易患白内障，由此得出结论：自然界中家鼠白内障发生频率的差异完全**可归因于** Aasdh 表达水平的差异。§§§§attributable to X 可归因于 X；solely / largely attributable to 完全 / 主要归因于；attribute v. 把…归因于（attribute X to Y） n. 属性，特征；attribution n. 归因；（作品）归属判定§§改译文：漏译 the level of expression of Aasdh

30067§canon§ˈkænən§n. （公认的）经典作品，正典；（某领域公认的）准则，标准；（宗教）教规，正典§For too long, scholars have focused on experimental versus conventional poetic forms, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among poems that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.§长期以来，学者们专注于实验性诗体与传统诗体的对立，从而阻碍了对诗歌之间其他文体对应关系的探究——而这些探究本可丰富我们对现代主义**正典**的理解。§His book The Canon of Medicine recorded the most advanced medical knowledge of his time.§他的《**医典**》一书收录了当时最先进的医学知识。§§the literary canon 文学经典；the modernist canon 现代主义正典；the canons of evidence 证据准则§§改例句2：句末「..」多了一个句点

30068§captivate§ˈkæptɪveɪt§v. 迷住；使着迷；吸引（人心）§However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a woman making tortillas.§不过在其他作品中，Villasana 也致敬普通人，正如她在那幅**令人着迷**的画作中呈现的一位正在做玉米饼的女性。§§§[构词] capt-（抓、拿）+ -ivate → 把注意力抓住§captivating adj. 迷人的（真题 18 次全为此形）；captive n. 俘虏 adj. 被囚禁的；capture v. 捕获§§

30069§concurrent§kənˈkʌrənt§adj. 同时发生的；并存的，并行的；（法律）并行的§Cross-references of that information with both archaeological and paleoecological records have revealed significant increases in clam size and productivity concurrent with the most prevalent use of these clam gardens.§将这些信息与考古记录、古生态记录交叉比对后发现，蛤蜊体型与生产力的显著上升，与这些蛤蜊养殖场使用最普遍的时期**同时发生**。§They found that using multiple diversification practices concurrently had greater potential for improving both nonagricultural biodiversity and yields than using a single strategy did.§他们发现，**同时**采用多种多样化实践，在改善非农业生物多样性和产量方面，比采用单一策略有更大的潜力。§§concurrent with 与……同时发生；concurrent trends 并行出现的趋势；concurrent jurisdiction 并行管辖权§concurrent trends 只说两种趋势同时出现，未必互相影响§

30070§contemporaneous§kənˌtempəˈreɪniəs§adj. 同时期的；同时代的§Archaeologists have observed similarities in the tools, such as bidirectional blades, uncovered at the Neolithic-period Mesopotamian settlement of Çayönü Tepesi and those uncovered at roughly contemporaneous settlements elsewhere in Southwest Asia, including those in the South Levant, Central Anatolia, and Central Zagros.§考古学家观察到，在新石器时代美索不达米亚定居点恰约尼丘（Çayönü Tepesi）出土的工具（如双向石叶），与西南亚其他地区大致**同时期**的定居点——包括南黎凡特、安纳托利亚中部和扎格罗斯中部的定居点——出土的工具存在相似之处。§§§§contemporaneous with X 与 X 同时期的；contemporary adj. 当代的；同时代的 n. 同时代的人；contemporaneously adv. 同一时期地§contemporaneous 强调「两者时间重合」；contemporary 还可指「当代的」§改译文：原译文是另一句（马耳他石器）

30071§convoluted§ˈkɒnvəluːtɪd§adj. 错综复杂的；费解的；盘绕的，回旋状的§President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as security operative Jack Caulfield and Attorney General John Mitchell.§理查德·尼克松总统最为人所知的是他在 1970 年代水门政治丑闻中的角色——那是一个**盘根错节**的犯罪与道德沦丧的故事，牵涉到一整批相关人物，如安全特工杰克·考尔菲尔德和司法部长约翰·米切尔。§§§§convoluted shells 回旋状的贝壳；convolution n. 盘绕；回旋（亦指脑回）§与 involved（参与的；复杂的）不要混写§改译文：漏译 Jack Caulfield 和 John Mitchell

30072§default§dɪˈfɔːlt§n. 违约，拖欠；默认（设置）；不履行义务，缺席 v. 违约；拖欠§Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth's research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and Milan from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including Eugene White's research on surpluses and state borrowing.§毛里西奥·德雷利希曼与汉斯-约阿希姆·福斯对腓力二世（1556 至 1598 年统治包括西班牙和米兰在内的帝国）债务**违约**的研究，与其他关于欧洲近代早期国家财政的著述相关联，其中包括尤金·怀特关于财政盈余与国家借贷的研究。§§§§debt defaults 债务违约；default on a loan 拖欠贷款；by default 默认；default judgment 缺席判决§§改译文：末尾译成了别人的研究（应为 Eugene White 关于盈余与国家借贷），并漏译括号

30073§entrepreneurial§ˌɒntrəprəˈnɜːriəl§adj. 创业的；企业家的；具有企业家精神的§For instance, a 1998 study by Ove Hansemark found benefits of entrepreneurial education for Swedish college students, but the study used a very small sample of only 19 students, making it difficult to say whether the training actually had an effect.§例如，Ove Hansemark 在 1998 年的一项研究发现**创业**教育对瑞典大学生有益，但该研究样本极小，仅 19 名学生，因此很难断言这种培训是否真的产生了效果。§In a study of business school graduates in Norway, researchers Lars Kolvereid and Øystein Moen addressed this question and convincingly demonstrated that participants showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs as a result of receiving entrepreneurial training.§在一项针对挪威商学院毕业生的研究中，Lars Kolvereid 与 Øystein Moen 探讨了这一问题，并令人信服地证明：参与者因接受**创业**培训而表现出强烈的成为创业者的意向。§§entrepreneurial training / education 创业培训 / 创业教育；entrepreneur n. 创业者；entrepreneurship n. 创业精神；创业活动§与 enterprising（有进取心的）近义但不完全等同§改例句2：删去误并进来的「Text 2」及其后另一篇的句子；改译文2：相应删去后半，补译 addressed this question

30075§extant§ɪkˈstænt§adj. 现存的；尚存的§Most of the island’s extant biota belong to clades with younger crown ages, however: Jérôme Murienne et al. found that the crown age of Grande Terre’s clade of cockroaches is 2.7 million years, for example.§不过，该岛**现存**生物区系大多属于冠群年龄较年轻的支系：例如 Jérôme Murienne 等人发现，格朗德特尔岛蟑螂支系的冠群年龄只有 270 万年。§The Roman historian Suetonius's De vita caesarum, a biography of the Roman Empire's first leaders, is an extant work: it can still be read.§罗马历史学家苏维托尼乌斯的《十二凯撒传》是罗马帝国首批统治者的传记，是一部 extant（**存世**）作品：至今仍可阅读。§§surviving adj. 现存的（同义替换，常作正确选项的等价表达）；extinct adj. 灭绝的；已失传的；extirpate v. 根除，使（种群）灭绝§extant ≠ extent（程度、范围），SAT 经典拼写陷阱；extinct 是其最直接的反义词§

30078§ingest§ɪnˈdʒest§v. 摄入；吞下；吞食§CLPs are transmitted when an infected host is ingested by an individual of another species, typically shielding CLPs from the external environment, whereas directly transmitted parasites are exposed to external conditions during transmission.§当受感染的宿主被另一物种的个体**吞食**时，CLP 便得以传播——这种方式通常使 CLP 与外部隔绝；而直接传播的寄生虫在传播过程中则暴露于外部环境条件之下。§So in one day, a humpback whale weighing 30,000 kg could eat 9,000 kg, while a northern right whale weighing 80,000 kg could ingest a whopping 24,000 kg.§因此一天之内，一头重 3 万公斤的座头鲸可吃掉 9000 公斤食物，而一头重 8 万公斤的北大西洋露脊鲸可**吞下**高达 2.4 万公斤。§§ingestion n. 摄入（真题另现 11 次）§ingest 是「吃进体内」，digest 是「消化」，是先后两步§

30092§archipelago§ˌɑːkɪˈpeləɡəʊ§n. 群岛；列岛§Like many other bird species that live only on the Hawaiian archipelago, the Kaua‘i ‘amakihi has adapted to life in a well-defined habitat, resulting in highly specialized physical and behavioral characteristics that aid the species in survival.§与许多只生活在夏威夷**群岛**的鸟类一样，考岛绿雀（Kauaʻi ʻamakihi）已适应了界限分明的栖息地生活，由此演化出高度特化的生理与行为特征，有助于该物种存活。§The Hawaiian archipelago is home to the kiwikiu (Pseudonestor xanthophrys), one of several bird species that can only be found on the islands.§夏威夷**群岛**是 kiwikiu（毛岛雀）的家园——这是只能在夏威夷诸岛找到的鸟类物种之一。§§the Hawaiian archipelago 夏威夷群岛（真题搭配）；island chain 岛链（同义表达）§archipelago 是一组岛（含其间海域），island 是单个岛§

30093§artisan§ˈɑːtɪzæn§n. 工匠；手艺人§This sped up the process of making clothing and, by freeing them from the need to push cord through holes manually, allowed artisans to make smaller holes and thus finer seams.§这加快了制衣流程，而且由于不必再手工把线绳穿过孔洞，**工匠**得以打出更小的孔，从而做出更细密的接缝。§And once the needle was invented, artisans could use finer cord and smaller holes, resulting in tighter, more thermally efficient seams in their clothing.§而一旦发明了针，**工匠**便能使用更细的线和更小的孔，使衣物的接缝更紧密、保暖效率更高。§§artisanal adj. 手工制作的（artisanal cheese / bread）；craftsmanship n. 手艺；craftsperson n. 手艺人§artisan 强调手工技艺，artist 强调艺术创作§

30094§assemblage§əˈsemblɪdʒ§n. 集合；组合；聚集物；（考古）器物组合§The 6.5-million-year gap between these fossil assemblages occurs in the context of considerable evidence of concurrent African-Eurasian faunal exchange.§在非洲与欧亚大陆同期动物群交流证据相当充分的背景下，这两组化石**组合**之间隔着 650 万年的空档。§Maltese lithic (stone implement) assemblages from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE exhibit notable characteristics.§马耳他公元前六七千年的石制品**组合**展现出引人注目的特征。§§fossil assemblages 化石组合；assemble v. 聚集；装配，组装§考古中指同一地点或层位出土的一批遗物；与 assembly 不同：assembly 多指「装配；集会；（机械）组件」§改译文：漏译 concurrent（同期）

30095§aversion§əˈvɜːʃn§n. 厌恶；反感；规避§The finding that a loss is felt more keenly than is a gain of the same value led the researchers to formulate the concept of loss aversion, which has since informed research in fields ranging from behavioral economics to medicine.§「同等价值的损失比收益让人感受更强烈」这一发现，促使研究者提出了「损失**厌恶**」的概念；此后这一概念影响了从行为经济学到医学等多个领域的研究。§They noted that it becomes more difficult for consumers to evaluate brand quality as line length increases and that consumers show high risk aversion during economic downturns.§他们指出，产品线越长，消费者越难评估品牌质量；且消费者在经济下行期表现出高度的风险**规避**。§§aversion to / toward X 对 X 的厌恶；loss aversion 损失厌恶（行为经济学核心概念）；risk aversion 风险规避；averse adj. 不愿意的，厌恶的（averse to risk 厌恶风险）§与 avert（v. 避免；转移目光）同根不同词性§

30096§beauteous§ˈbjuːtiəs§adj. 美丽的（beautiful 的古体、诗体）§There is a fair behaviour in thee, Captain; And though that nature with a beauteous wall Doth oft close in pollution, yet of thee I will believe thou hast a mind that suits With this thy fair and outward character.§船长，你身上有一种美好的举止；虽然造化常以**美丽**的外墙把污秽包藏其中，但我仍愿相信你有一颗与这美好外表相匹配的心。§§§§beauty n. 美；fair / comely adj. 美丽的（同为古语、文学色彩用词）§多见于莎士比亚及后世仿古文体，现代英语罕用，但 SAT 常考这类「古语色彩词」§改译文：删去英文里没有的场景说明「薇奥拉正在对一位出手相助的船长说话」

30097§carp§kɑːp§n. 鲤鱼 v. 吹毛求疵；挑剔抱怨§Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Lidia Eva Wysocki and colleagues found in a 2006 study of common carp.§长期暴露于人为噪声（交通、采矿等人类来源的声音）会影响动物——Lidia Eva Wysocki 等人在 2006 年对**鲤鱼**的研究中便发现了这一点。§While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that TiO₂-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as common carp (Cyprinus carpio), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.§虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但已有假设提出：斑马贝等无脊椎动物体内 TiO₂ 纳米颗粒的生物累积可发挥宝贵的指示作用，免去制造商对脊椎动物（如合规测试常用的**鲤鱼**）进行昂贵且具侵入性的采样——现行环保法律正要求此类检测。§§common carp 鲤鱼；carp at / about 对…吹毛求疵§动词义「吹毛求疵、挑剔抱怨」是书面义，与名词同形异义§

30098§cauldron§ˈkɔːldrən§n. （深口）大锅；（引申）动荡、混乱的局面§The halwai [baker] was already installed in front of the Mishthaan Sweet Shop, pressing jalebi batter into squiggly shapes that floated and simmered in the oil in a big iron cauldron.§做甜点的师傅早已在 Mishthaan 甜品店门前支好摊，把 jalebi 面糊挤成弯弯曲曲的形状，让它们浮在一口**大铁锅**的油里慢慢炸煮。§§§§a cauldron of emotions 情绪翻腾§常引申为「酝酿中的混乱局面」§

30099§clasp§klɑːsp§v. 紧握；（双手）交握；抱紧 n. 扣子，搭扣§Don Mariano Alamar was silently walking up and down the front piazza of his house at the rancho; his hands listlessly clasped behind and his head slightly bent forward in deep thought.§唐·马里亚诺·阿拉马尔在牧场宅邸前的门廊上默默来回踱步，双手无精打采地**背扣**在身后，头微微前倾，陷入沉思。§§§§hands clasped behind one's back 双手背在身后§双手背在身后是人物沉思、克制的经典体态描写§

30100§commodity§kəˈmɒdəti§n. 商品；（农矿）初级产品，大宗商品；（引申）可供取用的资源§In economics, soybeans are considered a commodity because they are essentially interchangeable, “essentially” being a word that admits a degree of latitude.§在经济学中，大豆被视为一种**大宗商品**，因为它们基本上可以互换——而「基本上」一词本身就留有一定余地。§A student consults a table showing projected changes in production and average market prices of agricultural commodities in four countries in a tariff-elimination scenario.§一名学生查阅了一张表格，表中列出在取消关税的情形下，四个国家**农产品**产量与平均市场价格的预计变化。§§agricultural commodities 农产品；commodity prices 大宗商品价格；commodity market 商品市场；attention as a commodity 被视为商品的注意力§§改译文：原译文是另一句（贝克曼的贸易报告）；补译文2
